source: Live network read on 16 Nov 2026. Plugin jars, plugin.yml, the console help index, and LuckPerms. Nothing on Discord was changed.

guide.description: Go on or off duty. The staff tag shows only while you are on duty. A player must run it. Other /staff actions refuse you until you are on duty.
Message other staff who are on duty.
Record a warning on the player. This is the warning command. There is no /warn.
Add a staff note on a player. It does not punish them.
Mute a player for up to 1 day.
Ban a player for up to 1 day. The word permanent is refused at this rank.
Show the staff notes, warns, mutes and bans recorded for a player.
Show a player's warn count, mute and ban at a glance.
Teleport yourself to an online player. You must be on duty.
Bring an online player to you. You must be on duty. Same permission as /staff tp.
Show a player's UUID, ban, mute and last logout.
Essentials mute. Config max-mute-time is -1, so this command has no time cap. Prefer /staff mute, which stops at 1 day for a Guide.
Players can send this. Guide and above also have essentials.helpop.receive, so the message reaches you.
List the plugins on this server.
Tells the player to open a Discord ticket. It does not file a report and it does not ping staff.
Last logout, ban, mute and UUID. Also granted to every player by Essentials player-commands.
Who is online. Also granted to every player by Essentials player-commands.

Who is online. Also granted to every player by Essentials player-commands.
Show the server rules.
Kick a player and record it. You must be on duty.
Vanish yourself. Only a player can use it, and only while on duty.
Open a read-only copy of an online player's inventory.
Essentials kick. minecraft.command.kick is granted as well.
Essentials temporary ban, including offline players. Config max-tempban-time is -1, so there is no 7-day cap on this command. Use /staff ban when the 7-day cap must hold.
Essentials vanish. You can also see vanished staff (essentials.vanish.see).
Essentials inventory view. essentials.invsee.preventmodify is set, so the inventory cannot be edited.
Open your ender chest, or another player's (essentials.enderchest.others).
Essentials teleport. This is separate from /staff tp.
Teleport a player to you.
Send a player to a jail, or release them. A jail must already exist.
Create a jail where you are standing.
Delete a jail. There is no /jail command.
Show information about an island. Alias /is admin show.
Visit an island. Bypass mode is denied at this rank. Alias /is admin teleport.
